notes.text:
Full review of PR #173 for the continuation attempt:

The headline is met and verified: on a devDependency scratch repo and on the self-checkout, `.codex/hooks.json`, `.github/hooks/kanban.json` and `.mcp.json` contain no machine path (`node "node_modules/hkb-cli/bin/hkb.js" hook stop` / `node "bin/hkb.js" …`, `{"command":"node","args":["…/bin/hkb.js","mcp"]}`), every command exits 0 from a plain `sh` in the project root and as bare argv, init is idempotent, doctor resolves all three; 768 tests, smoke green. Checked against the harness docs/source: Codex runs hooks through `$SHELL -lc` with cwd = session cwd (so `-C <worktree>` resolves the relative form); Copilot runs hooks in bash/PowerShell and is fail-open on agentStop; Claude Code resolves `.mcp.json` relative paths against the project directory and VS Code defaults stdio cwd to the workspace folder.

**Must do — the PR is CONFLICTING with main** (branch forked at da9b0a0; #150 landed since): the only conflict is `docs/wiki/log.md` (append-only, keep both). Merge origin/main. Then re-stamp `docs/wiki/features/web-board.md` — it covers `src/init.js`, which this PR changes; it is fresh on main, so "already stale at origin/main" in your result comment is not right.

**Should fix in the same pass:**
1. `src/mcp.js` ~431 `mcpLaunch` tests `onPath` before `projectBinRel` — the opposite order to `hkbCommandForHook` (src/init.js ~293, "an hkb the repo carries is the one that runs"). Measured: a devDependency repo initialised on a machine with a global `hkb` writes `{"command":"hkb"}` into `.mcp.json` while the hook files name `node_modules/hkb-cli/…`; a teammate without a global hkb gets a broken MCP server, and it contradicts the PR's own table row 1. Reorder, and add the test `mcpLaunch({ onPath: true, root, pkgRoot: <inside root> })`.
2. `docs/harnesses.md` ~35 ("anywhere else → `{"command":"hkb"}`, same") and `src/mcp.js` ~426 ("the absolute fallback is not written into a tracked file") are both false: with hkb neither inside the repo nor on PATH, `installMcp` writes `process.execPath` + an absolute `bin/hkb.js` into `.mcp.json` (pre-existing, but this PR documents it wrongly). Either give `.mcp.json` the same `shared` rule as the harness files (bare `hkb`), or fix the table, the comment and `checkMcp`'s "names this machine on purpose" (src/doctor.js ~234).
3. `src/init.js` ~955 + `src/mcp.js` ~470: the printed `~/.codex/config.toml` snippet now carries `args = ["node_modules/hkb-cli/bin/hkb.js","mcp"]`. That is a user-level file; Codex resolves it against whatever cwd `codex` starts in, so it is right in this one project and silently wrong everywhere else. Keep the absolute form there, or say it must be.

Nits, take what is cheap: `checkHarnesses` (src/doctor.js ~182) lacks `checkHooks`' portability finding (a bare `hkb` in a harness file on a self-carrying repo is ok if hkb is on PATH); init says nothing when it writes a bare `hkb` the machine cannot resolve (unlike the Claude path); `checkMcp` reports an absolute `node` form ok without checking the file exists; `harnessHookCommand` reads only `[0].hooks[0]`.

Filed separately as triage: the Copilot hooks JSON shape (`version: 1`, flat array with `bash`/`powershell` keys per the current reference) vs the Claude-shaped file `templates/copilot/hooks.json` writes — not this card's scope.

Same branch, same PR (worktree-kb-166-1). Rerun lint/test/smoke, then `hkb finish`.

Then per the full review re-posted just above: re-stamp web-board.md; mcpLaunch must prefer the repo-carried hkb over PATH like hkbCommandForHook does (+ test); fix the false claim that no absolute path is ever written to .mcp.json (or make it true); keep the absolute form in the printed ~/.codex/config.toml snippet.

residual_risk: Neither Codex's nor Copilot's hook-execution model (whether `command` runs through a shell) is documented anywhere I could find, and this session had no network access to verify against their docs/source. I deliberately chose the unguarded, argv-safe form (correct either way) over the guarded shell form (correct only if there's a shell, silently wrong otherwise) — documented in src/init.js's relativeHookCommand comment and in docs/harnesses.md/the wiki page. Worth a human spot-check against actual Codex/Copilot hook internals if that ever matters.

results.summary: installHarness (src/init.js) and mcpLaunch (src/mcp.js) called hkbCommandForHook()/projectBinRel() with no root, so a devDependency or self-checkout repo still got an absolute machine path in the tracked .codex/hooks.json, .github/hooks/kanban.json and .mcp.json (#146 fixed this for Claude's settings file but not these two call sites). Added relativeHookCommand (src/init.js): the project-relative, unguarded node "<rel>" hook <verb> form for a harness with no $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR of its own but that already runs its hook from the project root (Codex's -C <worktree>, Copilot's dispatcher-made worktree) — reached via hkbCommandForHook(verb, { cwd: true }). No [ -f ... ] || exit 0 guard: whether either harness runs the command through a shell is undocumented, and the guard's f="..."; syntax is only valid there, so the plain form is the one correct either way (cost: a hard failure instead of silence in the narrow window before npm ci). mcpLaunch grew a root param and uses the same projectBinRel remainder for the same reason. hkb doctor's checkHarnesses now also resolves the command it reads back out of the generated harness file (harnessHookCommand), and a new checkMcp does the same for .mcp.json. docs/harnesses.md documents all three writers side by side; docs/wiki/features/hook-install-shapes.md gets a matching section (re-stamped, now fresh).

residual_risk: Did not re-verify the devDependency-scratch-repo grep/spawnSync check from a real shell scratch repo this attempt (the sandbox denied mktemp/temp-dir bash commands this session) — relied instead on test/harness.test.js's existing equivalent coverage (spawnSync of the generated command from a real scratch dir, asserting no machine path appears), which passed.

9 other wiki pages remain stale at origin/main from unrelated prior work (architecture/overview, decisions/adr-004, features/auto-merge, operator-seat, planning-commands, review-loop, up-and-down, update-notice) — out of this card's scope, as attempt 1 already noted.

results.summary: Addressed the full review of PR #173 (continuation, attempt 3). Merged origin/main (conflict only in docs/wiki/log.md, resolved by keeping both branches' entries in date order). Fixed the three review items: (1) mcpLaunch (src/mcp.js) now checks projectBinRel before onPath, same order as hkbCommandForHook, so a repo-carried hkb wins over a global one on PATH when writing .mcp.json. (2) mcpLaunch's fallback when neither is available is now the plain `hkb` every teammate needs on PATH (a new `shared` param, default true) instead of an absolute machine path — matching what docs/harnesses.md and checkMcp already (falsely) claimed. (3) The printed ~/.codex/config.toml snippet — user-level, resolved by Codex against wherever it starts, not the project — now gets its own launch via mcpLaunch({ shared: false }): bare hkb or this checkout's own bin/hkb.js made absolute, computed independently in mcpSnippets/installMcp rather than reusing .mcp.json's project-relative launch. .vscode/mcp.json keeps the shared launch since VS Code resolves it the same way Claude Code does. Updated checkMcp's stale comment in src/doctor.js. Re-stamped docs/wiki/features/web-board.md (two src/init.js line anchors had drifted from unrelated insertions, no content change) and docs/wiki/features/hook-install-shapes.md (real content update describing the corrected fallback order and the new codex-only launch). Added a paragraph to docs/harnesses.md explaining the codex.toml/vscode.json split.
